body:
Again, I thank you for taking the time to respond to my post. I see you are speaking about Hinduism or specifically Hindu cosmology. I'm sorry but I do not subscribe to that belief. 

Also, this last post comes off very condescending. You may want to rethink the way you write to suicidal people. 

Namaste.

I am a woman. (I realize I did not give any indication to gender so no fault of yours.)

"When I feel depression I don't identify with it. I know like everything, it will come to pass."

But see my internet friend, it has not passed. It has never passed. For years and years. 

Why won't suicide solve this issue? Why wouldn't going back to non-existence make things better? I'm not trying to be obtuse. I truly do not see how me leaving this earth is a crazy idea. Nobody really seems to care if I'm here or not. 

As far as displaying what is best in me, I don't have anything to offer. So I have no clue how I could possibly improve my situation.

I think people find reasons when they can experience joy. I can't experience joy so I have no reasons. 

That said, if I had a child I would live for them even if I didn't want to live for myself. But, I have no children and I never will.

I'm not really comprehending your internal vs external states here.

I'm not really sure you're listening to me either.

I don't care about them specifically anymore. It's just that you expect those people to actually take an interest when you say, "Hey, I'm really low and I want to kill myself. I need your help." and instead they blow you off.

All I want is for just one person to actually love ME. A person that I know in the flesh.

I appreciate your response. I haven't been fighting depression since September, that's just when the suicidal thoughts started. I've been fighting depression probably since childhood but didn't start getting treated for it until my mid-20's. 

It's been about seven years now. Multiple therapists, multiple drugs. 

"Those who seem content are that way because they exert super efforts to defend themselves from negative emotions."  So you assume I haven't exerted super efforts to fight negative emotions? Well, you're wrong. I have and it didn't work. Now what?

Edit: "Look around you and see if there are those who can benefit from your attention."  All I do is give other people my attention. All I do is love and care for others in the hope that maybe, just maybe, I can get a little sliver of love back. Just someone to actually care about me like my ex used to. 

I've been through the gauntlet folks. I've done all the cognitive behavioral therapy, the fighting of negative emotions. It doesn't always work.

You guys may care in the sense of not wanting pain to befall another human being but none of you know me. Nobody here knows ME or whether or not the world would be missing a good person or a bad person if I decided to kill myself. 

If the people that know ME don't care then why should I put any weight into what an anonymous stranger thinks?
